subject: ROUNDED phrase
notes: Format: ROUNDED [ MODE IS { AWAY-FROM-ZERO | NEAREST-AWAY-FROM-ZERO | NEAREST-EVEN | NEAREST-TOWARD-ZERO | PROHIBITED | TOWARD-GREATER | TOWARD-LESSER | TRUNCATION } ], IS not underlined. Grammar `ROUNDED (MODE IS? roundingModeName)?` with roundingModeName = exactly the eight words; RoundingModes.Map maps each keyword to its CobolRounding (one mapping shared with DEFAULT ROUNDED). Probe: `ROUNDED MODE PROHIBITED` (IS omitted) accepted; MODE IS at --std 85/2002 rejected COBOL0803 'ROUNDED MODE IS requires COBOL-2014', accepted at 2014; bare ROUNDED accepted at 85/2002. cite.py --check 14.7.4.2 "MODE" -> OK §14.7.4.2. The 'COBOL-2002' edition labels in the grammar comment (CobolParserCore.g4 roundedPhrase), the lexer comment above AWAY_FROM_ZERO and the golden headers are stale (the gate and ConstructRegistry say 2014, consistent with D.17.3) - comment drift only, reported as a dossier gap. [editions as adjudicated: ROUNDED phrase: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023; the MODE phrase and its eight modes: 2014, 2023 (D.17.3: 'In earlier COBOL standards, only two methods of "final" rounding were provided')]
